known.via: English Wikipedia "Ribera del Queiles" (a wine place on Wikidata)

blurb.text: A vino de la tierra (IGP) spanning Zaragoza in Aragón and southern Navarre, covering towns such as Tarazona, Cascante and Ablitas. It sits one step below the DO level and gained its status in 2003.
